title: The fires of October 2017
summary: On 15 and 16 October 2017 fires across the centre and north killed about forty-five people in a day, in conditions the meteorological services had warned of. The minister of internal administration resigned within the week and the command of the civil protection was replaced; the second report of the Independent Technical Commission followed in 2018.
